metadata.title: Lamb Shanks in Red Wine - cooked in a Thermal cooker
metadata.description:
Lindi from ThermalCookware.com in Australia shows how to cook lamb shanks in a Thermos Shuttle Chef thermal cooker.
To purchase or for more information vist in UK - www.MrDsKitchen.co.uk or in Australia www.ThermalCookware.com. Why not visit our social networking site at http://thethermalcook.ning.com/ where you can exchange ideas with other thermal cooks?

nodes.plm_caption:
A woman in a blue shirt and black apron does most of the work in this video. There is a car and some trees visible in the background, which may be a camping environment. There are two men watching and eating while the woman cooks.
The woman has three pots open on top of the stove. The cooking is likely done using a thermal cookware (since the words "thermal cookware" appear on the screen at the bottom of the shot a few times) The pots are turned in different directions. Then she adds the meat to one of the pot and stirs. She then adds a carrot and onion mix in a separate bowl that she stirs with a spoon. She adds that to the meat, then she adds a liquid seasoning. Then she adds the carrots and onions with the meat to the pot, and she cooks it until it's done. She removes the pot from the heat and lifts it up to the table. She turns on a small blender and blends the food in the pot. She opens it and places it near the big pot that the food was cooked in. She then removes the lid of the large pot and stirs the food inside using tongs. Then she scoops it out of the pot with a plate and a spoon and puts it into a smaller pot. She uses tongs to put the cooked food in the smaller pot onto a larger plate. Then she puts the food on her own plate, which is on the table. She walks away to turn off the blender. Then she picks up a cake that was on the table, and holds it with her plate.
This video is set in an area with a fence and some trees. There is a car parked in the background with some camping supplies on top of it. The man in black is wearing a jacket with a logo on it and has a beard, as does the man eating the food on his plate. The woman's apron is visible as she cooks, and the blue shirt she is wearing can be seen under it. There is a large plate that is on the table. The cake that is being held has a layer of frosting on it and there is writing that comes out of the top.

summary.brief: Lindi browns lamb shanks, slow‑cooks them in a thermal cooker, plates the stew and presents a cake.
summary.detailed: The video opens with Lindi, dressed in a blue shirt and black apron, standing at an outdoor stove with three pots. She heats the inner stainless‑steel pot on the burner, browns the lamb shanks, then removes them. She sautés onions, garlic and a carrot‑onion mix until soft, deglazes the pot with red wine and a splash of vinegar and lets the liquid reduce. She returns the shanks, adds a tin of tomatoes and some stock, and simmers the mixture on the stove for about 25 minutes to ensure the heat reaches the meat. The contents are then transferred into the vacuum‑insulated outer container of the thermal cooker, the lid is locked, and the dish cooks for several hours without additional heat. After the long cook, Lindi lifts the cooker, uses a small hand blender to blend the sauce, and returns the blended mixture to a serving pot. She scoops portions of the meat and gravy onto a large plate, serves the stew to two men who are watching, and then walks away to turn off the blender. Finally she picks up a frosted round cake from the table, holds it on her plate, and smiles as the segment ends.

action.detailed: Brown the lamb shanks in the inner pot, add softened onions, garlic and carrots, deglaze with wine and vinegar, stir in tomatoes and stock, simmer briefly, transfer the mixture with the shanks into the insulated thermal cooker for several hours, then blend the sauce, plate the meat and gravy, and place a cake on the serving plate.
action.actor: the woman in the blue shirt and black apron

The video includes the woman cooking, first by putting a large metal pot with a lid on a burner. She opens the pot, adds ingredients, and stirs while talking about the food she is making.
The woman first adds pieces of sausage and vegetables into the pot, followed by a liquid. After that she adds pepper and a spice. Then she stirs the pot and covers it.
The background is an outdoors area. The camera focuses primarily on the woman. There are cooking utensils and food visible.

summary.brief: A woman cooks lamb shanks in a thermal cooker outdoors after a brief caravan‑style advertisement.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a short, upbeat advertisement showing rows of sausages being turned with tongs and on‑screen branding for a caravan company. Music plays and the screen displays the brand names. The scene then cuts to an outdoor kitchen where a woman wearing a blue shirt and black apron stands beside two portable stoves and several stainless‑steel pots. She points out the three pots, opens a lid, and places a pot on the right‑hand burner. She adds chopped onions and garlic to the pot and sautées them until soft. She deglazes the pot with red wine and a splash of vinegar, letting the liquid reduce briefly. Next, she adds canned tomatoes and stock, then returns the previously browned lamb shanks to the pot. She lets the mixture simmer on the stove for about twenty‑five minutes so the heat penetrates the meat. After simmering, she transfers the whole pot into the vacuum‑insulated outer container of a Shuttle Chef thermal cooker, secures the lid, and explains that the food will continue cooking safely for several hours without additional heat. She later opens the cooker, shows that the meat is fork‑tender and falling off the bone, plates the shanks with the rich sauce, and comments on the aroma and tenderness as the segment ends.

action.detailed: Brown the lamb shanks in a stainless‑steel pot, sauté onions and garlic, deglaze with wine and vinegar, add tomatoes and stock, simmer briefly on the stove, then transfer the pot into the insulated Shuttle Chef thermal cooker, lock the lid and let it finish cooking for several hours until the meat is tender, finally plate the shanks with the sauce.
action.actor: The woman in a blue shirt and black apron who is presenting the recipe

summary.brief: A woman demonstrates thermal‑cookware and prepares a meat stew using an insulated Shuttle Chef cooker.
summary.detailed: The video opens with the woman standing beside two portable burners, showing three different pots and their matching lids while explaining how thermal cookware works. She moves a pot from one burner to the other, fits its lid, uses tongs to handle the pot, adds a splash of liquid and gives the mixture a quick stir. Next she places raw meat pieces (chicken legs) into a pot of boiling water, lets them cook briefly, and lifts them out with tongs onto a tray. She then sautés chopped onion (and garlic) in the same pot, adds tomatoes, a white sauce and a pinch of black pepper, and returns the meat to the pot, stirring everything together. Finally she lifts the cooking pot and inserts it into a larger insulated cylinder called a Shuttle Chef, closes the lid, and lets the dish finish cooking while she talks about the product.

action.detailed: Place the meat in boiling water, remove it with tongs, sauté the onions, add tomatoes, white sauce and pepper, return the meat, then transfer the pot into the Shuttle Chef and close the lid to finish cooking.

summary_sent_to_llm.title: Lamb Shanks in Red Wine - cooked in a Thermal cooker
summary_sent_to_llm.description:
Lindi from ThermalCookware.com in Australia shows how to cook lamb shanks in a Thermos Shuttle Chef thermal cooker.
To purchase or for more information vist in UK - www.MrDsKitchen.co.uk or in Australia www.ThermalCookware.com. Why not visit our social networking site at http://thethermalcook.ning.com/ where you can exchange ideas with other thermal cooks?
summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video opens with Lindi, dressed in a blue shirt and black apron, standing at an outdoor stove with three pots. She heats the inner stainless‑steel pot on the burner, browns the lamb shanks, then removes them. She sautés onions, garlic and a carrot‑onion mix until soft, deglazes the pot with red wine and a splash of vinegar and lets the liquid reduce. She returns the shanks, adds a tin of tomatoes and some stock, and simmers the mixture on the stove for about 25 minutes to ensure the heat reaches the meat. The contents are then transferred into the vacuum‑insulated outer container of the thermal cooker, the lid is locked, and the dish cooks for several hours without additional heat. After the long cook, Lindi lifts the cooker, uses a small hand blender to blend the sauce, and returns the blended mixture to a serving pot. She scoops portions of the meat and gravy onto a large plate, serves the stew to two men who are watching, and then walks away to turn off the blender. Finally she picks up a frosted round cake from the table, holds it on her plate, and smiles as the segment ends.
action_list: Add onions and liquid to simmering lamb shanks
Close pot lid and carry pot
